ca.hsn: 5609 (articles of yarn/twine/cordage/rope n.e.s., e.g. 5609 00 20/90) most likely; 6307 90 (other made-up textile articles) is the main alternative. 5805/5810 do not fit (not hand-woven tapestry, not embroidery); 6304 (furnishing articles) is a weaker fit. Rate is 5% under every plausible heading at Rs 599.
ca.notes: Not a licensed CA; analysis for the owner's CA to confirm. GST: candidate had 12%, corrected to 5% (gst_pct updated 12 -> 5). Since 22-09-2025 (56th GST Council, Notification 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dt 17-09-2025) heading 5609 twine/cordage/rope articles (other than coir) moved 12% -> 5% [GST Council press release https://gstcouncil.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-09/press_release_press_information_bureau_0.pdf ; https://taxguru.in/goods-and-service-tax/impact-rate-rationalization-gst-2-0-regime-textile-sector.html ; https://www.credlix.com/hsn-code/560900 ; https://www.cmaknowledge.in/2025/10/gst-rate-changes-effective-22-09-2025-notification-09-2025-ctr.html], and Chapter 63 made-ups (6304/6307) are 5% up to Rs 2,500 per piece, 18% above (Notfn 9/2025 Sch I S.No. for Ch 63 / Sch II above Rs 2,500) [https://www.taxheal.com/?p=31615 ; https://tallysolutions.com/gst/textile-gst-rates/ ; https://taxclue.in/hsn-code/63072010]; Ch 58 (5805/5810) also 5% [https://tax2win.in/guide/special-woven-fabrics-gst-rate-hsn-code]. Sources are search snippets of secondary sites citing the notification; official CBIC/GST Council pages could not be fetched from this session. Licences: none found (no BIS QCO for textile decor; not electrical, not food-contact). Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011 apply to the pre-packed retail piece: name and address of manufacturer/packer (and importer if any), common/generic name, net quantity by number (1 N) plus dimensions 14x30 in, MRP inclusive of all taxes, month/year of manufacture/packing, consumer-care contact, country of origin (India); the same declarations must be shown on the website listing (LM Rules r.6(10) e-commerce, Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020). Supplier must put the label on the pack or the owner must supply one. 'Handmade' and '100% cotton' are product claims; policy require_evidence_for_claims means get the supplier's written confirmation/fibre declaration before using '100% cotton'. Tax path: both suppliers (Ghaziabad, Hapur) are in UP, no Odisha supplier found, so per docs/05 this can only be sold on TradeIndiaMarketplace.com (own website) via bill-to-ship-to (supplier bills owner's Odisha GSTIN with IGST, ships to customer; owner charges IGST/CGST+SGST by customer's state under IGST Act s.10(1)(b)). Amazon.in/Flipkart/Meesho are NOT reachable (pickup address must be on a registration in that state) unless an Odisha supplier is found; recommend.py still lists them as passing but that ignores the tax path. Margin after correction (recommend.py, 2026-10-22, base scenario, website shopify channel): at 5% GST and Rs 165 cost expected Rs 199.48/order, 38.01% margin (conservative Rs 131.56; marked fragile); at Rs 180 cost Rs 185.08, 35.26%. Both meet min 30% and Rs 60. (At the old 12% it was 33.87% / 30.95%.) Approve for website only, 1-2 piece sample first as the reviewer said.
confirm_with_real_ca: HSN for a cotton-rope macrame wall hanging: 5609 vs 6307 90 (vs 6304) and that the rate is 5% under Notification 9/2025-CT(Rate) as amended to date
Bill-to-ship-to from a UP supplier to Odisha GSTIN for website orders: place of supply, IGST charging, invoice and e-way bill format (needed above Rs 50,000 consignment)
ITC on the supplier's IGST invoice when goods never reach Odisha premises
That the supplier is GST registered and issues a tax invoice (small IndiaMART handicraft sellers may be unregistered or composition dealers, which would remove ITC and change the margin)
Legal Metrology label responsibility (supplier vs owner as packer/marketer) for drop-shipped packs
Whether GST is charged at 5% on the full sale price including any shipping fee collected from the customer
